title: Bank Holiday on November 9, 2026: What It Means for Your Finances
description: Banks in several Indian cities will observe holidays on Monday, November 9, 2026, for festivals like Diwali, Laxmi Puja, Govardhan Puja, and Vishwakarma Day. .

faq.q: ### Will ATMs be operational on November 9, 2026?
faq.a: Yes, ATMs are generally operational on bank holidays for cash withdrawals and balance enquiries. However, cash replenishment might be slower than usual if the holiday period is extended.

faq.q: ### Can I make online fund transfers like UPI or IMPS on a bank holiday?
faq.a: Yes, digital payment systems like UPI (Unified Payments Interface) and IMPS (Immediate Payment Service) operate 24/7, including bank holidays, allowing for instant fund transfers.

faq.q: ### What happens to cheques deposited on a bank holiday?
faq.a: Cheques deposited on a bank holiday will typically be processed on the next working day. This will lead to a delay in the funds being credited to your account.

faq.q: ### Do all cities observe holidays for Diwali, Laxmi Puja, Govardhan Puja, and Vishwakarma Day on November 9, 2026?
faq.a: No, bank holidays are often state-specific or regional. While Diwali (Laxmi Puja) is widely observed, Govardhan Puja and Vishwakarma Day holidays are more localised. Always check the official RBI holiday calendar for your specific city.

faq.q: ### Will NEFT and RTGS transactions be affected on November 9, 2026?
faq.a: NEFT (National Electronic Funds Transfer) usually operates 24/7, but settlement might be delayed to the next working day on some holidays. RTGS (Real-Time Gross Settlement) also generally operates, but it's advisable to check the RBI calendar for any specific RTGS holidays, which are rare.

faq.q: ### Are credit card payments or loan EMIs affected by bank holidays?
faq.a: If you have set up auto-debits for credit card payments or loan EMIs, they generally process as scheduled. However, if you plan to make a manual payment via a physical branch or cheque, ensure you do so before the holiday to avoid late payment charges.
